title: 802.11ax
short: IEEE 802.11ax-2021, also known as Wi-Fi 6, is a WLAN standard improves upon previous Wi-Fi standards by utilizing 1024QAM modulation, larger channel bandwidths, and improved efficiency.
desc: IEEE 802.11ax-2021, also known as 802.11ax, or Wi-Fi 6, is a standard of wireless networking that utilizes 1024QAM, OFDMA, MU-MIMO, and up to 160 MHz channel bandwidth to allow for more throughput and lower latency compared to previous standards. 802.11ax offers a peak theoretical speeds of 9.6Gbps, with real-world speeds reaching upwards of 1500Mbps.
